coordinates: x=source tile x,z=source tile y; centers at integer coordinates; original core owns collision, jump and transitions

pathMask.method: 4x4-pixel coverage from exact source composite, restricted to observed path/ledge metatiles; yellow palette RGB thresholds r>190,g>170,b<170

heightPolicy: Source elevation 0/3 denotes collision layers, not metric terrain height. Walkable floor remains y=0. Low .28-tile-high south-facing ledge berms occupy actual MB_JUMP_SOUTH cells; no invented continuous terraces or independent collision.
